description:
Two calendar-inventory models: camping as nightly stays (check-in/check-out, occupancy rules, per-night pricing) and cabanas as day-slot resources tied to a park visit; parking inventory.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Camping books date ranges with no double-occupancy; pricing per night
- Cabana books per visit day and requires/links a same-day park admission
- Both models reserve through the contention-safe inventory core

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

**Amended (grilling):** per ADR-005, cabanas/parking attach to day slots and camping to date ranges, all reserving through the same claim core.

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
Backlog grilling 2026-07-12 (owner decisions): lodging grounded in ADR-005 dated-slot model.
